summary: Live contract for promoting the inventory wiring shadow adapter to a live writer. Activation is GATED by a dedicated env flag and a verified user-side inventory source collection. This document is the ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA the future apply MUST honor.

scope.heroes: all canonical heroes; Borea aliases NEVER allowed
scope.writes: gift_transaction_ledger row + user_gift_inventory decrement + user_affinity_state increment in a single atomic transaction
scope.reads: user_gift_inventory and user_affinity_state are read first; if either source missing for the user, return 412 precondition_failed (NO partial write)

request_flow_order: 1. Reject Borea hero_id (404) BEFORE any other check
2. Reject if runtime flag AFFINITY_GIFT_RUNTIME_ENABLED is not on (423)
3. Reject if user_id not in Stage1 allowlist (423)
4. Pull idempotency_key; on duplicate, return existing ledger row WITHOUT decrementing inventory or incrementing affinity
5. Validate gift_id exists in catalog (404 if not)
8. Insert ledger row {tx_id, idempotency_key, user_id, gift_id, hero_id, quantity, canary:true, inventory_mutated:true, affinity_points_mutated:true, created_at_utc}
idempotency_contract: Same (user_id, idempotency_key) MUST return the same tx_id
Replay MUST NOT decrement inventory a second time
Replay MUST NOT increment affinity_points a second time
Replay MUST NOT insert a duplicate ledger row
Replay response payload MUST flag result=idempotent_replay
economy_cap_contract: per-user daily gift quantity cap honored
rollback_compensation_contract: If COMMIT fails, transaction MUST abort entirely (no partial writes)
If a partial state is detected later (ledger row with no inventory decrement, or inventory decrement with no ledger row), emit a compensation ledger row {compensation_required:true, references_tx_id}
Reverse procedure: lookup ledger row by tx_id -> +qty to inventory, -delta to affinity, mark row reversed=true
All compensation flow MUST be idempotent
abort_triggers_post_activation: duplicate idempotency creates duplicate inventory/affinity mutation
ledger row without matching inventory event
buffs activated true on any row
battle_engine.py / battle_core.py / combat.tsx git diff non-empty
feature_flag_safety_rules: flag MUST be off if any required precondition fails
flag MUST be turned off immediately by rollback script if any abort trigger fires
flag MUST be set via supervisor backend.conf env (audited and versioned), NOT runtime API

non_activation_safe_block_path.action: do_not_activate; produce READY_NOT_ACTIVATED result with blocked_by_missing_inventory_source=true and clear remediation steps
remediation_steps: create user_gift_inventory collection with schema {user_id, gift_id, quantity, updated_at_utc}
seed Stage1 QA users with realistic balances (e.g. quantity=10 of gift_test_001)
create user_affinity_state collection with schema {user_id, hero_id, affinity_points, updated_at_utc}
verify atomic multi-document transaction support on MongoDB instance
